name: jev-page-tester
description: OMP-supervised exploratory browser testing with official Jev decisions

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/unit.test.js dist/tests/bridge.test.js dist/tests/existing-tab.test.js
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/browser.test.js dist/tests/borrowed-browser.test.js
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js demo
scripts.fixture: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js fixture
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:mcp
